name: Farm on Demand (FD)
aliases: processor farm paradigm with on-demand distribution
definition: A parallel isosurface extraction algorithm based on the processor farm paradigm where balancing is obtained dynamically, provided enough partitions (tasks) are generated. It represents the fourth class.
summary: Farm on Demand is a parallel isosurface extraction algorithm that achieves dynamic load balancing by distributing fine-grained tasks to workers on demand.
